verdict.rationale: Name.com is a domain registrar and domain-management API, not an AI agent or host application that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only that Name.com publishes MCP servers (the server role) for external agents like Cursor and Claude Desktop. That is a different story and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
